A '''''[[tachi]]''''' (太刀) is a type of Japanese curved sword.

==Other uses==
* Tachi (大刀), Heian Era sword, a version of the {{ill|Chokutō|en|Chokutō|qid=Q63821|lt=Chokutō}} (直刀), a Japanese straight sword
*A Japanese term for {{ill|karate stances|ca|Postures de karate|de|Karatestellungen|gl|Posicións de karate|it|Posizioni del karate|pt|Bases do caratê|vi|Tư thế đứng tấn trong Karate|qid=Q1512259|lt=karate stances}}, varying body positions to attack and defend
*A suffix used in the Japanese language to indicate that a word refers to a group, see the article on [[Japanese grammar#Nouns and other deictics|Japanese grammar]]
*{{ill|TOM'S|es|TOM'S|fr|TOM'S|it|TOM'S|ja|トムス|pl|TOM’s|pt|TOM'S|ru|TOM’S|zh|TOM'S|qid=Q1773593|lt=TOM'S}} (Tachi Oiwa Motor Sports), TOM'S Co., Ltd (株式会社トムス, Kabushiki-gaisha Tomusu), a factory supported racing team and tuner of Toyota and Lexus vehicles
